A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including rewriting forms, borrowing, and simplifying results

skills.name: Rewrite equivalent forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into an equivalent subtraction-ready form, such as finding a common denominator, normalizing an improper mixed number, simplifying a fraction part, or expressing a whole number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator and converts fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when the solution rewrites a mixed number with an improper fraction part into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction part before subtracting.
Tag when the solution rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the actual subtraction after forms are already aligned.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping from the whole part.
Do not tag for final simplification of the answer after subtraction unless the step is clearly a preparatory rewrite before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Perform subtraction once the quantities are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers without regrouping.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions that already have the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number problem when no borrowing is needed in that step.
Tag when the solution subtracts after an LCD conversion has already been completed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding the LCD or rewriting numbers into equivalent forms.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag for simplifying the final result or combining parts into final notation.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup by taking 1 from the whole-number part and converting it into fractional units so subtraction can continue when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for merely rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator before any borrowing occurs.
Do not tag for final simplification or combining the answer.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or integer by combining whole and fractional parts when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines a whole-number result and a fractional result into a mixed number.
Tag when the solution expresses a zero fractional part as an integer or removes a zero whole part from a mixed-number form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for preparatory rewrites done before subtraction.
Do not tag for the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including rewriting, borrowing, and simplifying results

skills.name: Match fraction units
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions so they are expressed in compatible units before subtraction, such as finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align mixed-number parts.
Tag when a mixed-number or fraction expression is rewritten so fraction parts can be subtracted in the same denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag pure simplification after subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper fraction part inside a mixed number; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has a nonstandard or improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly normalizes an improper fraction part inside a mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of standalone fractions.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no borrowing is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solver subtracts whole parts and fraction parts directly in a mixed-number problem without regrouping.
Tag when the solver combines the direct subtraction result into a final fraction, mixed number, or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating common denominators or rewriting forms before subtraction.
Do not tag cases where the fractional subtraction goes negative and the solver must borrow; that regrouping belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Regroup or simplify result
skills.definition: Adjust the subtraction result when direct subtraction is not yet in final form, including borrowing/regrouping across whole and fractional parts or reducing a fraction/zero result to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole-number part to continue fractional subtraction.
Tag when the solver converts a negative fractional part into a valid mixed-number result by regrouping.
Tag when the solver simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction that already yields a final lowest-term result without regrouping or simplification.
Do not tag finding a common denominator or rewriting whole numbers with 0 over a denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that belongs to S02.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including rewriting forms, borrowing, and simplifying results

skills.name: Rewrite fractional form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into an equivalent subtraction-ready form, such as finding a common denominator, normalizing a mixed number with an improper fraction part, simplifying a fraction part before subtraction, or expressing a whole number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step converts unlike fractional parts to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a step normalizes a mixed number whose fractional part is improper into a standard mixed number.
Tag when a step simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number before subtraction.
Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align whole and fractional parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag routine subtraction once the numbers are already in compatible form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction creates a negative fractional part.
Do not tag final simplification of the answer unless the step is explicitly a preparatory rewrite before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over an unchanged common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when the subtraction step may temporarily produce a negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators or otherwise rewrite forms before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag final combining or simplification steps unless actual subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup by taking 1 from the whole-number part and converting it into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed 1 is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not require regrouping.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as having 0 fractional units before any need to borrow is identified.
Do not tag final simplification or combining after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms after subtraction.
Tag when a zero fraction is rewritten as 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a mixed number or integer final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory simplification done before subtraction; that belongs to rewriting the input form.
Do not tag subtraction or borrowing steps themselves.
Do not tag classification statements such as naming a problem type.
